gen.title: How quicksort partitions around a pivot and recursively sorts
gen.quote: Pick an element from the array (the pivot), partition the remaining elements into those greater than and less than this pivot

claims.text: Quicksort has running time Θ(n²) in the worst case
claims.quote: Quicksort has running time Θ(n²) in the worst case, but it is typically O(n log n).

claims.text: Select can be used to always pick good pivots
claims.quote: Select can be used to always pick good pivots, thus giving a variant with O(n log n) worst-case running time.

claims.text: There are many variants of the basic scheme above
claims.quote: There are many variants of the basic scheme above: to select the pivot, to partition the array, to stop the recursion or switch to another algorithm for small partitions, etc.
